summary: Tested the Security Blog, SOP Library (12 SOPs, 5 free, ₹499 bundle), SIEM simulator (SPL + KQL, time filters, timeline zoom, saved searches, dashboards, alerts), Scenario Labs (6 labs, MCQ and text tasks, keyword auto-scored report, Kali terminal) and regressions. Backend: 31 of 31 pytest pass, with one blog cron call (401 without the secret, 200 with it, duplicate detected). Ad-hoc edge testing found a 500 on SPL '| sort <field>' across mixed sourcetypes. Frontend: all flows pass across anonymous, student and admin. I fixed one bug: clicking a timeline bar did nothing because recharts v3 removed activePayload. The click now zooms to that hour and I verified it (6 events for that hour).

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error (TypeError: '<' not supported between float and str) when the sort field is numeric in some events and missing or non-numeric in others. Repro: q='* | sort -bytes_out' or '* | sort status'. siem_engine.run sort key returns float for some events and str for others. Fix: use a tuple key, e.g. (0, n) if numeric else (1, str), or catch TypeError.

minor.issue: '| stats count' with no 'by' clause is parsed as 'stats by count' and returns one row {value:'-', count:N} labelled field 'count'. The regex needs whitespace after 'count'.

'summarize count()' with no 'by' returns 400 'Unsupported KQL operator: summarize ... Try ... summarize', which contradicts itself. 'summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)' splits on the comma inside bin() and adds a bogus field '1h)'.
Keyword scoring is a literal substring match. For example, lab-dns-tunnel 'dns tunneling' misses the British spelling 'tunnelling'. Consider synonyms or variants per keyword.
The backend watches /app/backend/tests and reloads whenever a test file changes. Harmless, but SIEM LOGS regenerate with a new base time on each reload.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: clicking a bar did nothing because recharts 3.6 chart onClick no longer passes activePayload. It now falls back to rows[activeIndex].

issues: Search runs only on Enter. Clearing the input does not reload the list until Enter is pressed again, and there is no search button.
A category with no posts (e.g. Ransomware) shows an empty grid. Consider an empty-state message.
Google News fallback cards for BleepingComputer have no image and show a placeholder shield (expected).
The unlock box renders only after /payments/config resolves. For about 1 second the access card shows just the price line, with no skeleton.

action_items: Fix the siem_engine sort TypeError (500) on mixed numeric/string or missing fields
Support SPL '| stats count' without 'by' and KQL 'summarize count()' without 'by'; ignore bin() when splitting summarize by-fields
Optional: add keyword variants (tunnelling/tunneling etc.) to lab report scoring
Optional: blog search debounce or search button; empty-state for categories with no posts
critical_code_review_comments: routes_blog.summarize uses model 'claude-sonnet-5-5'. The sync worked (8 posts added this session), so it is valid in this environment.
routes_practice /siem/alerts evaluates alert queries with SPL token match only (shlex). Fine for the seeded alerts, but KQL-lang alerts would not work.
list_posts accepts unbounded 'limit' param capped to 200 - OK; regex search escaped - OK.
SOP locked preview correctly omits steps/queries/escalation; report_keywords/answers correctly stripped from lab detail.

success_rate.backend: 95% (31/31 planned tests pass; one 500 found in ad-hoc SIEM sort testing)

seed_data_creation: Student account solved lab-bruteforce (report best 75) and all lab-dns-tunnel tasks (report 70). Admin solved lab-kerberoast k2. Student has a saved search 'TEST_ui_saved'. The cron run added 1 blog post (13 total).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n0 from /app/backend. Deselect TestBlog::test_cron_auth_and_dupe to avoid triggering an LLM blog sync. Console 401s on public pages come from /auth/me for anonymous users and are benign. The server clock in preview is about Oct 2026, and SIEM logs are relative to backend boot time. Payment keys are not configured, so the SOP pay buttons are disabled and the sop-pay-not-configured message shows (verified).
